details: Grayscale Investments formally withdrew its SEC registration statements for spot ETFs tracking Cardano (ADA), Polkadot (DOT), and Hedera (HBAR) on August 7, 2026. This move, characterized as a strategic pause rather than an SEC rejection, removes a near-term catalyst for institutional adoption of these altcoins.
title: Grayscale Withdraws Cardano, Polkadot, Hedera ETF Filings

details: Standard Chartered forecasts Chainlink's LINK token to reach $200 by the end of 2030. This optimistic projection is based on anticipated significant growth in tokenized real-world assets, expected to hit $4 trillion by 2028, and a 37x expansion in the DeFi sector, leveraging Chainlink's crucial role as an oracle.
title: Standard Chartered Predicts Chainlink (LINK) to Hit $200 by 2030

details: Robert Mitchnick, BlackRock's Head of Digital Assets, indicated a noticeable shift in Bitcoin's sentiment, noting its increasing decoupling from traditional equities, particularly AI stocks. Bitcoin demonstrated relative resilience during July's AI sector pullback, strengthening its case as a portfolio diversifier.
title: BlackRock: Bitcoin Sentiment Turning, Decoupling from Equities

details: BlackRock has reduced the minimum threshold for in-kind conversions for its Bitcoin ETF from $25 million to $1 million. This change aims to make the process more accessible for institutional investors looking to create ETF shares directly using Bitcoin holdings.
title: BlackRock Lowers Bitcoin ETF In-Kind Conversion Minimum to $1M

details: Bitcoin surged above $65,000 following a weaker-than-expected US jobs report for July, which showed a decline in payrolls. This data has tempered expectations for further Federal Reserve interest rate hikes, generally boosting sentiment for risk assets, including cryptocurrencies.
title: Bitcoin Tops $65K as Weak US Jobs Report Eases Fed Rate Hike Fears

details: Riot Platforms, a prominent crypto mining company, saw its stock jump 25% in after-hours trading. This surge followed reports of a significant $9.1 billion AI deal with Anthropic, signaling the company's notable expansion and strategic pivot into the artificial intelligence sector.
title: Riot Platforms Stock Jumps 25% on $9.1B AI Deal with Anthropic

details: Keel Infrastructure has ceased all US Bitcoin mining operations, reporting a $65 million net loss in Q2. The company is now completing a full pivot to artificial intelligence and high-performance computing infrastructure, repurposing its former mining sites for these new endeavors.
title: Keel Shuts US Bitcoin Mining, Pivots to AI After $65M Loss

details: Trump Media & Technology Group mutually terminated its proposed $6.42 billion CRO treasury venture with Crypto.com. The decision, citing prevailing market conditions and shifting priorities, has led to a notable decline in the value of the Cronos (CRO) token.
title: Trump Media Scraps $6.42B CRO Treasury Deal with Crypto.com

details: Dogecoin (DOGE) is showing early signs of a potential recovery, trading near $0.070. Technical analysis indicates a bullish momentum divergence, and on-chain data points to whale accumulation, suggesting that selling pressure may be fading and a positive outlook could be emerging.
title: Dogecoin Price Forecast: Bullish Divergence, Whale Accumulation

details: Ripple (XRP) has fallen to a 20-month low, while Cardano (ADA) and Solana (SOL) are struggling to gain upside momentum. These top altcoins are maintaining a bearish tone, reflecting a broader risk-averse sentiment in the cryptocurrency market.
title: Top Altcoins: XRP Hits 20-Month Low; ADA, SOL Lack Momentum
